module.name: hal_base_driver
module.details: This abstract class is the common ancestor of all HAL stateful HAL drivers.

config.name: HAL_USE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION
config.brief: Enables the mutual exclusion APIs on driver instances.
config.note: Disabling this option saves both code and data space.

config.name: HAL_USE_REGISTRY
config.brief: Enables the HAL registry for drivers.
config.note: Drivers are added to the registry explicitly, using @p drvRegister().
Disabling this option saves both code and data space.

class.name: hal_base_driver
class.brief: Ancestor class of stateful HAL drivers.

field.name: name
field.brief: Driver name, @p NULL if not registered.

method.name: __drv_stop
method.param: Driver state when the stop was requested, it allows the class to abort an operation in progress.

method.name: __drv_set_cfg
method.brief: Reconfigures a ready driver with a specified configuration.
method.note: The configuration pointer is retained by the driver, it is not copied. The referenced object must be immutable and remain valid until another configuration is selected or the driver is stopped.
method.retval: If the configuration has been rejected.

method.name: __drv_sel_cfg
method.brief: Reconfigures a ready driver with one of the pre-defined configurations.
method.note: With the driver configurations table disabled (@p XXX_USE_CONFIGURATIONS set to @p FALSE) only configuration zero exists, it is the low level driver default configuration, the same used by @p drvStart() with a @p NULL configuration. With the table enabled the configurations are the entries of the application table, configuration zero is its first entry and an empty table has no configurations.
The returned configuration pointer can be retained by the driver without copying and must remain valid for the whole time it is in use.
method.retval: If the selected configuration does not exist.

method.name: drvStart
method.details: Starts driver operations. When called from @p HAL_DRV_STATE_STOP the peripheral is physically initialized using the specified configuration. If @p config is @p NULL then the low level driver default configuration is used. Calls while the driver is already @p HAL_DRV_STATE_READY with @p config equal to @p NULL are ignored, calls with a non-@p NULL configuration perform a live reconfiguration equivalent to @p drvSetCfgX().
method.note: The low level driver default configuration is configuration zero of @p drvSelectCfgX() only when the driver configurations table is disabled, see @p drvSelectCfgX().

The function can fail with error @p HAL_RET_INV_STATE if called while the driver is already being started or stopped. In case you need multiple threads to perform start and stop operation on the driver then it is suggested to lock/unlock the driver during such operations.
method.retval: If the driver was in one of @p HAL_DRV_STATE_UNINIT, @p HAL_DRV_STATE_STARTING or @p HAL_DRV_STATE_STOPPING states.
If a live reconfiguration is requested and the configuration is invalid and has been rejected.
If a required resources cannot be allocated.
If a required HW resource is already in use.

method.name: drvStop
method.details: Stops driver operations. The peripheral is physically uninitialized.
method.note: In SMP systems the callbacks are invoked, outside the system lock, by the core serving the driver interrupts. When called from a different core the function can return while the last callback is still executing, resources used by the callback must not be released until it has returned.

Low level drivers can require the function to be called from the core that started the driver, for example when the interrupt vector is enabled on that core only, refer to the low level driver documentation.

method.name: drvSetCfgX
method.details: Applies a new configuration to a started and idle driver. The configuration structure is architecture-dependent.
method.retval: If the driver is not in @p HAL_DRV_STATE_READY state.
If the configuration is invalid and has been rejected.

method.name: drvSelectCfgX
method.brief: Live reconfiguration using one of the pre-defined driver configurations.
method.note: With the driver configurations table disabled (@p XXX_USE_CONFIGURATIONS set to @p FALSE) only configuration zero exists, it is the low level driver default configuration, the same used by @p drvStart() with a @p NULL configuration. With the table enabled the configurations are the entries of the application table, configuration zero is its first entry and an empty table has no configurations.
method.param: Driver configuration index to be applied.
method.retval: If the configuration is invalid and has been rejected.

method.name: drvRegister
method.brief: Adds the driver to the HAL registry.
method.details: The driver is registered under the specified name, it can then be found by name and enumerated. Names are unique.
method.note: The name string is not copied, it must remain valid while the driver is registered.
This function must be called after @p chSysInit().
method.retval: If another driver is registered with the same name.

method.name: drvUnregister
method.brief: Removes the driver from the HAL registry.
method.note: Does nothing if the driver is not registered.

method.name: drvGetNameX
method.retval: If the driver is not registered.

method.name: drvUnlock

variable.name: hal_registry
variable.brief: List header for the HAL registry

function.name: drvInit
drvRegGetFirstI
function.brief: Return the first driver in the HAL registry.
function.note: The registry is enumerated with the system lock held, drivers can be registered and unregistered otherwise.
function.return: A pointer to the first driver object.

function.name: drvRegGetNextI
function.brief: Return the next driver in the HAL registry.
function.note: The registry is enumerated with the system lock held, drivers can be registered and unregistered otherwise.
function.return: A pointer to the next driver object.
function.retval: If there is no next driver.

function.name: drvStartByName
function.details: Returns a reference to the driver, on the 1st open the peripheral is physically initialized. An implementation-dependent default configuration is used for initialization.
function.note: Only the drivers added with @p drvRegister() can be found.
function.param: Pointer to store the error code or @p NULL. Note that in case of driver not found the returned code is @p HAL_RET_SUCCESS.

function.name: drv_reg_insert
function.brief: Driver insertion in the HAL registry.
function.note: This function is only available when HAL registry is enabled.
function.param: Pointer to the @p hal_base_driver_c instance to be inserted.

function.name: drv_reg_remove
function.brief: Driver removal from the HAL registry.
function.param: Pointer to the @p hal_base_driver_c instance to be removed.
